title: ESP32-S3 Sentinel
summary: A $4 always-on ESP32-S3 sentinel that runs a local char-LSTM decision tier and only wakes a richer gateway when confidence drops. 11.6 tok/s H512 hardware-verified.

title: AiDENs
summary: A closed-loop self-learning AI that audits its own knowledge graph, detects gaps, generates tasks, executes them via LLM, and captures results as provenance-attributed facts — all local-first, all autonomous.

title: ClaimLedger
summary: A claim and evidence compiler for Gloss Claim Hygiene, producing source-spanned, reviewable, deterministic bundles and testimony objects.

title: Gloss
summary: A local-first desktop knowledge application for grounded chat over personal documents, with notebook-local storage and source-linked answers.

title: Palisade
summary: A native Linux firewall control surface for nftables with privilege separation, validation, snapshots, and rollback.

title: projmind
summary: A Rust CLI daemon that maintains a local knowledge base about software projects using structure scans, git tracking, and Ollama analysis.

title: Recall
summary: An operator-grade local memory and control runtime built around daemon authority, receipts, evidence, and repair handoffs.

title: RecursiveIntell Rust Libraries
summary: The Rust crate workspace behind the evidence-runtime stack: semantic memory, runtime contracts, verification, queues, schemas, and quantization research.

title: Sortarr
summary: A Rust daemon and React UI for organizing self-hosted media libraries with metadata matching, dry-run planning, and review gates.

title: VisionForge
summary: A Tauri 2 app that connects Ollama and ComfyUI through a local prompt-engineering, queue, gallery, and generation-receipt workflow.

title: semantic-memory: The Memory System Behind AiDENs
summary: A typed knowledge graph with provenance, bitemporal search, contradiction detection, and 48 MCP tools. Available now on crates.io.
